result.notes: Free self-serve signup on the Plaid Dashboard grants Sandbox and Limited Production (capped, real-data) API access immediately with client_id/secret auth. Unlimited/full Production access requires submitting an application and, for Link, an OAuth registration form plus a use-case description - a review gate beyond pure self-serve. Plaid publishes an official AI coding toolkit (github.com/plaid/ai-coding-toolkit) containing a Sandbox MCP server plus a Dashboard MCP, so MCP support is official rather than community-only. REST API is medium breadth (~198 endpoints per apis.guru spec).
result.one_liner: Plaid is a fintech API platform that lets developers securely connect to users' bank accounts for balance, auth, identity, transaction, and payment data.
